mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate (measured as the change in FEDFUNDS over the last month) signals an easing monetary policy, which is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in periods of FEDFUNDS decline are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 4.0% signals economic weakness, which is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE > 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) both rise above their recent levels (INDPRO > 102.0 and HOUST > 1330.0), it signals strong economic activity, which is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO > 102.0 and HOUST > 1330.0.

mechanism_narrative: When the quarterly growth rate of real GDP (GDPC1) exceeds 2.0% (annualized), it signals a late-cycle expansion, which is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of instances when GDPC1 growth rate > 2.0%.
